notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Rugby Champions has been updated. The purpose of this update is to further balance the gameplay after the most recent update. Most notably,

- The defensive performance of your AI teammates has been improved
- The effectiveness of break tackles has been reduced
- The ability of both teams to effect turnovers has been increased

These changes make the game flow more like rugby, and make tactical kicking for territory a more feasible strategy. This is primarily because of the increased risk  of being turned over when running the ball from risky positions, and the improved ability to hold ones own defensive line.

As always, we appreciate your feedback in helping us tweak the gameplay, and look forward to hearing your feedback. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: MAJOR GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
This update focuses on gameplay and features the following,

-	New offload animations which allow for more rapid and realistic offloading. This includes blocking of offloads on angles where a defender in the tackle is preventing this.

-	New mauls which combined with the new offloads allow for more dynamic phase play. Press ‘B’ on attack to improve your chances of holding up the tackle and forming a maul. This also improves your chances of being able to offload and also opens up the possibility of popping the ball the halfback (press ‘X’)

-	Kick pressure and charge downs. Approaching the kicker on the angle at which he is trying to kick now places pressure on him which can result in a charge down or him having to alter the trajectory of his kick and potentially losing distance on the kick. When attacking take care to place your own kicks away from pressuring defenders to avoid charge downs.

-	New tackle animations and less players committed to the tackle area.

-	New break tackle animations and break tackle system which allows you to pre-program break tackles before contact. This makes the game very much more combative like real rugby where every tackle is a battle. Be sure to try and break tackles when going into most contact situations. The AI will do this and it makes them lethal from close range, so be careful turning the ball over in your own end.

-	Expect to get busted of more often when trying to make a tackle. You can improve your chances by diving into the tackler rather than just running into him, but at the risk of messing up the timing leading to a potential break.

-	Improved support play at rucks which allows you to hold onto the ball for long periods. But beware, the AI can do the same.

-	Lineout mini game featuring a timing meter. Lock the meter with ‘Y’ to pass the ball off the top of the lineout, or with ‘B’ to hold it in and drive. The more you middle the meter the better your chances of winning the lineout.

-	Scrum mini game featuring a timing meter. Press ‘Y’ and try and lock the meter in the middle to improve your chances of a powerful drive.

-	New No. 8 runs from the scrum. Press ‘B’ to initiate these once the ball is won and be sure to hold the direction you want to run before the No. 8 picks up the ball.

-	Driving in a tackle on defence now requires that you have a player in the tackle

-	The AI will now sometimes bail out of kicks if there is too much pressure and look to launch an attack instead.

-	There are now less intercepts. If players are unsure of the intercept they will instead look to rush up and put in a strong tackle.

-	In game statistics are now viewable at any time during the match.

As always, don’t forget to sprint when you need to (hold ‘A’) and add a player or two to the ruck (tap ‘Y’)

Thanks for your support, and we look forward to hearing you feedback and ideas for improvement. Future updates of Rugby Champions will look to incorporate your feedback to get the gameplay base as good as it can be. Other features like new competitions, game modes, and improved graphics will be reserved for Rugby Champions 2 😊

Have fun!

notes.title: Rugby Champions Update
notes.notes:
Rugby Champions has been updated to include the following,

- A Celtic League competition format has been added featuring 14 teams from Ireland, Wales, Scotland, South Africa and Italy

- Match engine improvements including fixing of the scrum right side run exploit and bug where play continues after a ball is knocked back infield after going into touch

- Improved player passing accuracy, so that there are not excessive passes going to ground

- More realistic simulation of tackles going to ground vs staying up. This means that it is now harder to get offloads away without forward momentum, and also harder to offload when there are multiple defenders in the tackle

notes.title: Rugby Champions Update
notes.notes:
-	The default gameplay camera has been zoomed out to improve playability

-	The gameplay camera zoom and tilt can still be modified to suit your preference, and your preferred settings will now be remembered each time you play a game

-	The side steps have been improved so that they are more realistic, requiring later execution closer to the defender than they previously did

-	The speed of slow-motion kicking has been increased to provide better flow

-	An in-game controller guide now displays during gameplay to ease the learning curve for game controls. These can be turned off during match play by going to the Settings menu

-	The crowd audio has been improved to offer a more immersive experience

-	The volume of music and SFX can now be adjusted independently to suit your preference
